task_spec: Add search_insert(arr, target): binary search returning the index of target or its insertion point in ascending-sorted arr.

bugs.description: When arr[mid] < target the code sets lo = mid instead of lo = mid + 1. If mid == lo (which happens when hi == lo+1), lo never advances and the while loop spins forever (infinite loop / hang). Correct is lo = mid + 1.

provenance.note: subtle algorithmic infinite-loop bug; hard to verify without simulating
